name: coree
description: Persistent memory and code intelligence for AI agents - stores decisions, discoveries, and gotchas across sessions using local vector + BM25 search.

interface.shortDescription: Persistent memory and code intelligence across sessions.
interface.longDescription: Coree gives Codex persistent memory and hybrid code search. It stores architectural decisions, gotchas, and discoveries in a local vector + BM25 database and injects the most relevant context into each session automatically.
